description: Positional lysine conservation in AIG1/ADTRP C-termini across vertebrates, and compartment specificity of the C-terminal dilysine motif in human TM proteins
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
from scipy.stats import binomtest
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

o=pd.read_csv("out/ortholog_anchored_cterm.csv")
# rebuild full sequences for positional profile
seqs={}
for gene in ["AIG1","ADTRP"]:
    df=pd.read_csv(f"out/orth_{gene}.tsv",sep="\t").dropna(subset=["Sequence"])
    m=dict(zip(df.Entry, df.Sequence)); seqs[gene]=m

prof={}
for gene in ["AIG1","ADTRP"]:
    g=o[o.gene==gene]
    tails=[seqs[gene][a][-20:] for a in g.acc if a in seqs[gene]]
    n=len(tails)
    f=[]
    for k in range(1,21):               # k = distance from C-terminus
        f.append(np.mean([t[-k]=="K" for t in tails if len(t)>=k]))
    prof[gene]=(np.array(f), n, tails)
    bg=np.mean([f[i] for i in range(20) if (i+1) not in (3,5)])
    for pos in (3,5,4):
        k=int(round(f[pos-1]*n))
        bt=binomtest(k, n, bg, alternative="greater")
        print(f"{gene}: Lys at -{pos} in {k}/{n} = {100*f[pos-1]:.1f}%  vs background Lys freq in tail {100*bg:.1f}%  binomial p={bt.pvalue:.2g}")
    print()

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(16,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(1,21)
for gene,c in [("AIG1","#2b6cb0"),("ADTRP","#c05621")]:
    f,n,_=prof[gene]
    ax.plot(x,100*f,"-o",color=c,ms=4,label=f"{gene} (n={n} species)")
ax.axvspan(2.6,3.4,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=.10); ax.axvspan(4.6,5.4,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=.10)
ax.invert_xaxis(); ax.set_xlabel("position from C-terminus (-1 = last residue)")
ax.set_ylabel("% of vertebrate orthologs with Lys")
ax.set_title("Lysine is fixed at -3 and -5 in AIG1 orthologs"); ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.set_xticks(x[::2])

ax=axes[1]
lab=["ER membrane\nGO:0005789","Golgi membrane\nGO:0000139","plasma membrane\nGO:0005886"]
vals=[11.30,2.63,1.54]; base=1.90
ax.bar(lab, vals, color=["#2b6cb0","#a0aec0","#c05621"])
ax.axhline(base, ls="--", color="k", lw=1)
ax.text(2.45, base+0.25, "proteome base rate 1.9%", ha="right", fontsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i, v+0.25, f"{v:.1f}%", ha="center", fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("% of human TM proteins ending in KKxx or KxKxx")
ax.set_title("C-terminal dilysine marks ER membrane proteins\n(OR 8.6, Fisher p = 7.5e-39)")

ax=axes[2]
sub=["all TM≥1","multipass TM≥4","TM≥6"]
er=[61.8,55.0,49.2]; pm=[30.3,40.0,41.3]
w=0.36; xi=np.arange(3)
ax.bar(xi-w/2, er, w, color="#2b6cb0", label="ER membrane")
ax.bar(xi+w/2, pm, w, color="#c05621", label="plasma membrane")
ax.set_xticks(xi); ax.set_xticklabels(sub)
ax.set_ylabel("% of dilysine-ending proteins annotated to compartment")
ax.set_title("Compartment of human TM proteins\nthat end in a dilysine motif"); ax.legend(frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
